purpose: Define a machine-readable manifest connecting active canonical identities to their physical source artifacts for packaging, review and replacement without making file paths semantic authority.

does_not_own: child semantic content unless explicitly stated

topics.name: Repository Manifest
topics.purpose: Define a machine-readable manifest connecting active canonical identities to their physical source artifacts for packaging, review and replacement without making file paths semantic authority.

semantics.identity_rule: Manifest maps identity to file/source; file/source does not define identity.
semantics.active_rule: Every active canonical definition has an explicit manifest/source mapping.
semantics.orphan_rule: Unreferenced physical files may exist but are not active solely by presence.
semantics.duplicate_rule: One active identity cannot silently map to conflicting active source artifacts.
semantics.package_rule: Review ZIPs may include PATCH_MANIFEST files, but repository manifest is the assembled-tree inventory.
semantics.trace_rule: Manifest supports source provenance without becoming semantic owner.

invariants.rule: Repository activation, migration state, validation state and replacement decisions are explicit and machine-readable.

hard_gates.condition: physical file becomes active solely by existence
one active identity maps to conflicting active sources

references.purpose: Manifest inventory is validated against active Master roots.
